name: softcap_out
description: Soft-capping activation: out = softcap_const * tanh(x / softcap_const), evaluated in float32. x and out have the same shape; out is always float32 regardless of x.dtype. Returns a newly allocated tensor and does not mutate x. The autotune argument is accepted for SGLang API compatibility but is ignored; a deterministic size-based launch heuristic is used. Suites exercise bfloat16 x with float32 output and softcap_const=30.
